feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: One or more RSS/Atom/JSON feed URLs.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Hard cap on items returned per feed (0 = no cap).

sinceDate.title: Since (ISO date)
sinceDate.description: Only return items published at/after this date, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z. Empty = no lower bound.

untilDate.title: Until (ISO date)
untilDate.description: Only return items published at/before this date. Empty = no upper bound.

includeContent.title: Include full text/content HTML
includeContent.description: When off, returns title/link/date/author/categories only (cheaper payloads).

title: Feed reader input
description: Configure feeds, date window and output detail.
